description: Explain the lead time for a new order. Production takes 5 to 7 working days once payment clears, outside peak seasons, then courier transit of about 2 to 5 working days. Returns the ranges and a plain-language summary safe to share. Never quote a dispatch or delivery date: weather and production set them. Call this when a customer asks 'when will it arrive?'.

order_date.description: ISO date string of the order placement date (e.g. '2026-05-18'). Defaults to today.

name: get_delivery_estimate
